title: Removal Lines Claimed in a Final Mold Supplement — Insurance Claim Services
content:
**Rule.** In the Insurance Claim Services final mold supplement, the removal is taken as follows: for growth in an attic or crawlspace, the insulation removal lines and the debris disposal loads billed on the job, because attic insulation leaves the building as bagged debris; for growth in a basement, the drywall removal lines billed on the job; for growth anywhere else, the drywall removal and insulation removal lines billed on the job.

Lines are those billed on the Mold Remediation job awaiting clearance, at the amount billed.

- Attic or crawlspace: insulation removal plus debris disposal; drywall removal is not claimed.
- Basement: drywall removal only; insulation removal is not claimed.
- Living area or HVAC system: the drywall removal and insulation removal lines billed on the job.

*Hypothetical:* a crawlspace job billing insulation removal of 285.00, two debris disposal loads of 165.00 each and drywall removal of 120.00: 615.00. A basement job billing drywall removal of 340.00 and insulation removal of 90.00: 340.00.
